BiblicalUsage: Kishshalon is a tottering, a ruin waiting to happen. Proverbs 16:18 sets it beside the most quoted warning in the book: pride goeth before destruction, and an haughty spirit before a fall.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the totter comes before the fall: pride does not drop a man all at once, it sets him swaying first.
